name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. DUB prefers direct MKV. SUB follows AniYomi-style FlixCloud master parsing with robust child-playlist discovery, then uses the shared Limitless FlixCloud proxy for child-playlist rewriting and media-segment decoding.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME, AniYomi playlist parsing, and FlixCloud reference implementations

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME Test Direct
scrapers.description: Temporary diagnostic provider. Tries Re:ANIME HD-2 direct MKV downloads for both DUB and SUB and does not use HLS or Cloudflare. Kept separate so the primary Re:ANIME provider remains untouched.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus diagnostic build
